chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Jibraeel (peace be upon him) descended to me with the khilal (toothpick).

key_terms.الْخِلَالِ: The toothpick (specifically used for cleaning teeth)

ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic origin of using the toothpick in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, traces the origin of the toothpick (khilal) to a direct revelation from Angel Jibraeel to the Prophet Muhammad, underscoring its status as a divinely inspired practice rather than merely a cultural habit. In Shia scholarship, this links physical purification (taharah) closely with spiritual cleanliness, reinforcing the Prophet's role as the recipient of both the Quran and practical guidance for daily life. The narration highlights the importance of oral hygiene in maintaining ritual purity, a key component of Shia fiqh.
